name: qa-oracle
notes: A CONTROL, NOT A HARNESS. It reads the reference answer the dataset stages at `.oracle/answer.txt` and submits it through the same `qa` CLI an agent would use, then stops. It exists so `data/datasets/<name>/control.py --platform` can prove a QA dataset's VERIFY path reaches reward 1 through eval.runner.run_one. It contains no reasoning and is never offered to a method.
